niche_preference_profile: Prefers interfaces that feel calm, polished, and intentionally structured: light or softly premium surfaces in many contexts, generous whitespace, clear hierarchy, restrained headers, and coherent sectioning. They consistently like guided flows with obvious next steps, strong but selective emphasis on primary actions, and layouts that avoid clutter. They also respond well to refined, modern styling with rounded components, integrated imagery when it supports mood, and content that feels complete and purposeful rather than empty or unresolved.

criteria.description: Generous whitespace, open layouts, and steady vertical rhythm rather than compressed or tightly stacked content.
Strong, legible hierarchy with bold headlines, clear section separation, and obvious focal points instead of flat or fragmented emphasis.
Interfaces that clearly guide the user through steps with explicit progression, visible next actions, and setup framing rather than passive or ambiguous flows.
Cleaner screens with fewer competing interface elements, less promotional framing, and reduced visual noise.
A soft, polished, understated, premium-feeling aesthetic with modern refinement rather than harsh, generic, or overly theatrical styling.
Well-organized, complete, and consistent grouping of content into intentional sections or modules, avoiding unresolved, mixed, or awkward component logic.
Compact, minimal headers with restrained branding and cleaner title treatment instead of oversized, photo-dominant, or overly busy top bars.
